reason: Distractor set is politically charged: "feminism" offered as a candidate opposite of "equality" (implies feminism opposes equality), alongside "supremacy" (white-supremacy association); "supremacy"/"domination" are also arguable opposites of equality.
Wrong option "visionary" (impractical, idealistic) is a listed near-antonym of "realistic" — second defensible opposite.
Gloss for "steady" is the boyfriend/girlfriend noun sense ("A person loved by another person") — wrong sense shown to the child for wobbly/steady.
Wrong option "wholesome" (beneficial to health, salutary) is a defensible synonym of "beneficial".
"illustrative" (clarifying by examples, per gloss) does not mean "descriptive" — weak/related word, not same meaning.
Wrong option "monstrous" (and arguably "abominable") is a standard synonym of "hideous".
A birdhouse is a small nest box; an aviary is a large enclosure — not the same meaning. Wrong option "abattoir" (slaughterhouse) is also needlessly grim for children.
Earthenware is a KIND of pottery (low-fired clay); "pottery" is broader, not same meaning.
Wrong option "oblong" (elongated, egg/oval-shaped) is commonly given as a synonym of "oval"; second defensible answer.
A silhouette is a dark outline/shape, not a shadow — related words, not the same meaning.
Gloss itself says a pinafore is a sleeveless DRESS resembling an apron — not the same as an apron (only true in one UK sense); ambiguous.
A chauffeur is a KIND of driver (one paid to drive someone); "driver" is the broader word, not same meaning.
Potpourri means "medley" only in a secondary sense (kids know it as dried petals); wrong option "horehound" is obscure and sounds like a crude word; "cardamon" is a misspelling of cardamom.
Wrong option "sleight" means deceitful craftiness (cunning), and "trickery" is also close — second defensible synonyms.
Wrong option "considerate" is a dictionary sense of "attentive" (heedful of others' comfort); also "careful" is only a loose match for attentive.
Gullet is the oesophagus (gloss: passage from pharynx to stomach) — narrower than "throat", not the same meaning.
A boutique is a KIND of (small, fashionable) shop — narrower word, not same meaning.
A chrysalis is a butterfly/moth pupa — narrower than "pupa", not same meaning. Wrong option "teat" is an unsuitable body word for this audience; "anopheles"/"tunicate" obscure.
"ugly" is a stronger word than "unattractive" (unattractive < ugly < hideous) — the app's "Stronger and weaker" link describes the pair better than "Same meaning".
Tailoring (suits, fitted garments) is not dressmaking — related crafts, not same meaning; wrong option "corset" is also unnecessary.
Wrong option "neurotic" is a stigmatising mental-health label often used as an insult.
Wrong options "antagonistic" and "militant" (and "defiant") are synonyms of "combative" — multiple defensible answers.
Gloss for "irrational" is the maths sense ("A real number that cannot be expressed as a rational number") — wrong sense for rational/irrational as opposites of reason.

Gloss for "leave" is the noun sense ("period of time absent from work") — wrong sense for arrive/leave; wrong option "went" (past of go) also invites a child to treat it as a valid opposite of arrive.
Gloss for "deep" is the noun sense ("The central and most intense or profound part") — wrong sense for shallow/deep.
Gloss for "humble" is the verb sense ("Cause to be unpretentious") — wrong part of speech for proud/humble.
Gloss for "cloudy" ("Lacking definite form or limits") is the wrong sense; wrong option "stormy" is also a defensible opposite of "sunny".
Gloss for "quiet" is a noun sense ("A period of calm weather") — wrong sense for loud/quiet.
Gloss for "rare" ("Not widely known") is not the sense that is the opposite of "frequent" (happening seldom) — mismatched teaching.
Gloss for "calm" is the noun sense ("Steadiness of mind under stress") — wrong sense for stormy/calm weather.
Wrong option "absinthe" is an alcoholic drink — alcohol word unsuitable for 8–15.
"benignity" is obscure, and the wrong options (neoplasm, cyst, marrow, fibrosis) frame "benign" as tumour/disease vocabulary — grim and confusing against the gloss "kind and gentle".
"abettal" is an extremely rare form (abetment is standard) — too obscure; distractors are adult crime terms (felon, larceny, barratry).
"pleura"/"pleural" is specialist anatomy (lung lining) — too obscure even at level 9; distractors equally technical (mastoid, peritoneal).
"enteron"/"enteric" is specialist zoology/medical vocabulary — too obscure for level 8.
"mesoderm"/"mesodermal" is embryology jargon — too obscure for level 7.
Wrong option "melon" is the most natural category for cantaloupe ("a cantaloupe is a kind of melon") — a second defensible answer; "vine" describes the plant, not the fruit.
"carcajou" is obscure (another name for the wolverine), and "wolverine" appears as a wrong option — confusing; "cracidae" also obscure.
Wrong option "sulfide" is also a valid category: pyrite is iron sulfide (iron disulfide).
"amboyna" is an obscure timber name — too obscure for level 8.
Magnesia is magnesium oxide, a chemical compound (the mineral form is periclase) — "a kind of mineral" is not cleanly true; obscure.
"friedcake" is obscure/regional (a doughnut) — too obscure; calling it a kind of "cake" is also doubtful.
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; "aquilegia" is also obscure (columbine).
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; "caladium" obscure.
"mustelid" is a zoological family term — too obscure for level 7.
"curassow" is obscure for level 8 (as are distractors muntjac, merganser, jerboa).
Wrong option "twill" is also a valid category: gabardine is a tightly woven twill fabric.
Gloss for "dish" is the dishware sense ("A piece of dishware ... container for holding or serving food") — wrong sense for quiche as a dish of food.
A pyre is a pile of wood for burning (usually a funeral pyre) — not a KIND of wood; also carries a death/cremation association.
Iodoform is an antiseptic chemical compound, not "a kind of sweet" — link false; word obscure.
"cantaloup" is a variant spelling; wrong option "melon" is the natural category (a cantaloupe is a kind of melon) — second defensible answer.
"cassia" is obscure and ambiguous (a genus of trees and shrubs, and also a cinnamon-like spice) — "kind of shrub" is not cleanly true.
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; "euphorbia" obscure.
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; "ageratum" obscure.
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; "althaea" obscure.
A rhizome is an underground plant STEM (part of a plant), not a kind of plant; gloss for "plant" is also the factory sense.
"japonica" is an obscure botanical epithet (Japanese quince/camellia) — too obscure for level 7.
Wrong option "buttock" is a body word children treat as crude/insulting (cf. "butt") — unsafe for this audience.
Wrong option "obesity" is a stigmatising body term; "indulgence" (overindulgence, excess) is also a defensible synonym of "excess".
Wrong option "ornamentation" is the primary synonym of "embellishment" — better answer than "exaggeration" (only a secondary sense).
A schematic is a KIND of diagram (gloss: diagram of an electrical or mechanical system) — narrower, not same meaning.
Fluorescence is a KIND of luminescence — narrower/broader pair, not same meaning.
A bean is a kind of legume (legume is the broader family incl. peas, lentils) — not same meaning.
A boutique is a KIND of shop — "shop" is broader, not same meaning; wrong option "lyon" is a lower-cased place name.
"metazoa" is a taxonomic group name (all multicellular animals), not a kind of animal; obscure.
"gramma" (grama grass) is obscure and reads as a spelling of "grandma" — confusing.
"caragana" is an obscure plant genus — too obscure for level 8.
A thallus is a plant BODY (part of an alga/lichen/liverwort), not a kind of plant; gloss for "plant" is also the factory sense.
Wrong option "turnip" is also a defensible category: rutabaga is the swede / "yellow turnip".
Distractor set (pigmentation, whiteness, complexion, melanin) clusters skin-colour words around "discolour/discoloration" — reads as racially loaded; unsafe framing.
Gloss for "innocent" is the noun sense ("A person who lacks knowledge of evil") — wrong sense for guilty/innocent.
Wrong option "fright" (and arguably "panic") is a standard synonym of "dread".
"liter"/"litre" is a US/UK spelling variant of one word, not a pair of synonyms — confusing as a "same meaning" analogy in a spelling app.
A portfolio (gloss: large flat case for loose papers/drawings) is not a briefcase — related objects, not same meaning.
A magistrate is a KIND of judge (lay/lower-court judge) — narrower, not same meaning.
Grease is a KIND of lubricant (gloss: a thick fatty oil used to lubricate) — narrower, not same meaning.
At level 1 "beating" reads as physical violence; gloss "act of overcoming or outdoing" is the winner's sense, which makes wrong options "win"/"victory" defensible — ambiguous.
Belly is the abdomen; gloss gives "stomach" as the internal organ — not the same meaning. Wrong option "posterior" (bottom) is also a snigger word.
Smog (gloss: air pollution by smoke and fog) is a kind of haze, not the same as haze.
Gloss defines exhaustion as "Extreme fatigue" — a stronger/weaker pair, which the app's "Stronger and weaker" link describes better than "Same meaning".
"grumble" primarily means complain; matches "rumble" only in a weak secondary sense — ambiguous for a child.
For children "bike" means bicycle first; motorcycle is only a secondary sense — ambiguous. Wrong option "scooter" (motor scooter) muddies it further.
Wrong option "correctness" is a listed synonym of "exactness" — second defensible answer.
Wrong option "sheen" (a shine/gleam) is close enough to "sparkle"/"gleam" to be defensible.
"tavern"/"bar" are alcohol-venue words, unsuitable at level 2; gloss for "bar" is also the wrong sense ("A long straight piece of solid metal or wood").
Wrong option "dickens" contains a crude slang word; "romantic" -> "idealist" relies on a rare noun sense children will read as love/romance; "masculinity" also out of place.
"limber" as a vehicle (gun-carriage cart) is archaic/obscure; children know "limber" as flexible — confusing.
"acquisition" is broader than "purchase" (a purchase is one kind of acquisition — gloss: acquiring possession) — not same meaning.
Fumes are not "a kind of cloud" in any clear sense; wrong option "vapor" is at least as defensible a category for fume (fumes are vapour/gas).
Wrong option "ashamed" (and "unhappy", as in "feel sorry") are listed synonyms of "sorry" — second defensible answers.
Gloss for "line" ("people or things one BESIDE another") describes a row/rank, not a queue (one behind another) — inaccurate teaching.
Shopping (searching for and buying) is not the same as purchasing; wrong option "acquisition" is an equally defensible synonym of purchasing.
Wrong option "bulk" (size, volume) is a standard synonym of "size" — second defensible answer.
Gloss for "buy" is the noun sense ("An advantageous purchase") — wrong sense for sell/buy at level 1; wrong option "bought" is a form of the answer itself.
Prairie and steppe are region-specific grasslands (gloss ties steppe to Russia/Siberia) — related, not same meaning; wrong options include proper names lower-cased ("abel", "alaskan", "sahara").
Wrong option "vile" (wicked, depraved) is a listed synonym of "vicious".
A kettle is not a kind of metal — link false (at best "made from").
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; "vegetable" is the more natural category for broccoli.
"schist" is pronounced like a common swear word — a guaranteed snigger/double-meaning for 8–15.
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor") — wrong sense; children know turmeric as a spice, so "plant" is not the clear category.

A clan is a subgroup (kin group), not the same as a tribe; gloss "(usually preliterate) people" is a loaded/colonial framing; "ethnic" used as a noun-like distractor is dated and potentially offensive.
"penetrate" carries a sexual double meaning for older children, and "enter" -> "penetrate" (pass through by overcoming resistance) is not the same meaning.
Wrong option "conjecture" is a standard synonym of "supposition" — second defensible answer.
A chauffeur is a KIND of driver (one employed to drive someone) — narrower, not same meaning.
A melody is the tune — one part of a song (which also has words); related, not same meaning.
Compost is a KIND of fertilizer (gloss: any substance such as manure ... used to make soil fertile) — narrower/broader, not same meaning.
Gloss says the hearth is "The floor of a fireplace" — a PART of a fireplace, so the item contradicts its own gloss as "same meaning".
A monolith is a single large block/monument made OF stone, not a kind of stone; wrong option "pillar" muddies it further.
A defendant (accused in court) is not the same as a suspect (under suspicion) — related legal words, not same meaning.
For children "confidence" means self-belief; "certainty" matches only one sense weakly. Wrong option "secrecy" also fits the "in confidence" sense.
"several" (more than two, not many) and "some" (an unspecified amount) are not the same meaning; gloss "Quantifier" teaches nothing.
Wrong options "malice" and "resentment" are listed synonyms of "animosity" — multiple defensible answers.
"recipient" is broader than "beneficiary" (gloss: "A person who receives something"); a beneficiary is a particular kind of recipient.
Wrong option "lingerie" (women's underwear) is unsuitable for 8–15; "plaid" is also a fabric, muddying the category.
Gloss for "plant" is the factory sense ("Buildings for carrying on industrial labor"); seaweed is also scientifically algae, not a true plant.
Authority means rightful power, not just power; wrong option "leadership" is an arguable synonym; "authority" is advanced for level 1.
"ornis" is an extremely obscure word (the bird life of a region), and it is not "a kind of bird".
Lumber is sawn timber — a kind of (processed) wood; "wood" is broader. Wrong option "plank" is also arguably defensible.
Feasting (eating a lavish meal) is not the same as dining (gloss: eating dinner) — related, not same meaning.
Wrong option "tramp" is a pejorative for a homeless person and a sexual insult — unsafe for 8–15.
Rainfall is one KIND of precipitation (snow, sleet, hail are others) — narrower, not same meaning.
Gloss for "memorial" is the wrong sense ("A recognition of meritorious service"); wrong option "tomb" (a monument over a grave) is arguably defensible; grave-themed distractors.
"brush" reads first as a hairbrush/paintbrush for children — ambiguous; wrong option "bracken" (fern undergrowth) is arguably also a synonym of undergrowth.
